## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with flowers at church before taking her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) immediately become close friends, swearing a vow of eternal friendship in the Barrys' garden. After returning home overjoyed, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a package of chocolates from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that she is glad they kept [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school together via the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path), discussing school gossip, classmates, and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head and is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), refusing to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is humiliated by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) at school, first by being made to stand in front of the blackboard and later by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after arriving late. Outraged, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) vows never to return to school or forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), ignoring his attempts to apologize. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who recommends letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues to study at home and dramatically frets over her future friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) attend a political rally in town, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) spend a quiet evening together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help for her baby sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who is severely ill with the croup while their parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with young children to treat [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through the night until [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives with a doctor. Grateful for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saving her daughter's life, Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the past wine incident and welcomes her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) once again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

> During a gathering of schoolmates, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts a dangerous dare to walk across a high roof, resulting in a fall that fractures her ankle. While recovering under Marilla's care, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the accident and stays updated on local news, including the arrival of a popular new teacher.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and blossoms under the encouragement of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically talks to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about her schoolwork, field afternoons, and Miss Stacy's plan to host a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert for a schoolhouse flag. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) dismisses the concert as unnecessary nonsense, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) warmly supports Anne's excitement as she prepares her recitations and roles.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

> Noticing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lacks fashionable clothing like her peers, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly seeks to buy her a new dress for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas). After an awkward encounter at a local store, he enlists the help of Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to make a dress with puffed sleeves. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the new dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and a pair of slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), going on to shine in the school concert that evening.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of dainty kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) on [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning. Later that evening, the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) concert takes place, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shines in her recitations and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) performs a solo. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk home discussing the event, and later [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) reflect by the fire on how proud they were of Anne's performance.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home from an [Aid](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) meeting expecting tea, but finds that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has accidentally dyed her hair green after buying dye from a peddler. Unable to wash the dye out, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is forced to crop Anne's hair short. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) endures the embarrassment at school and resolves to focus on being good rather than pretty.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to pay for Anne's extra studies so she can eventually earn a living as a teacher. After joining the class, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels a mix of sorrow over [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) not joining, excitement about their future ambitions, and ongoing academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) continue their academic rivalry through the school year, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets ignoring him. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach the Queen's class next year, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to lock away her books and embrace summer vacation. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), learns about Matthew's failing health, and praises Anne's remarkable growth and beauty to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys an active summer outdoors following a doctor's recommendation and returns to her studies in autumn with renewed vigor. Over the winter, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) prepares the Queen's class for the daunting [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices Anne's rapid growth and growing maturity, feeling a quiet sense of loss as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for her future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid a emotional farewell to Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) at the end of the school term. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) travels to town to take her Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations, detailing her nervous experiences in a letter to [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Weeks later, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the published pass list to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), revealing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire [Island](../codex/places.md#island), bringing immense pride to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) looks on with quiet pride. [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) drives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) to the hotel, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially experiences severe stage fright upon seeing the sophisticated crowd and accomplished performers. However, catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) sparks her determination, leading her to deliver a glowing recitation that wins enthusiastic applause and praise from the audience.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives an encore performance that delights the audience and garners praise from attendees and professionals. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) enjoy supper before [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) drives them home under the moonlight, while the girls discuss the evening, wealth, and contentment with their lives.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) return from a shopping trip in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) discussing plans for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). Upon seeing a Jersey cow in Mr. Harrison's oat field, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly assumes it is her own mischievous cow, chases it out with Diana's help, and impulsively sells it to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). After arriving home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers her real cow [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) in the barnyard and realizes she sold Mr. Harrison's cow, prompting her to set off to apologize to him with a nut cake peace offering.
>
> — v2 · II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive along the [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) road to canvass for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village Improvement Society's hall painting fund. They deal with the dour Miss [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md) and her optimist sister Catherine, assist a frantic Mr. Blair with baking a cake, and carefully navigate Mrs. Theodore White's spotless home, securing subscriptions along the way.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), encountering various eccentric neighbors, including a remarkably tidy woman and a father celebrating the birth of his new son. Capitalizing on the newborn boy's arrival, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) to make a generous donation. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a subscription, but he flatly refuses.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed as a prank. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises not to tell [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) on the condition that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) refrains from doing it again, and she carefully removes the toad from the bed before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) discuss Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the village improvement projects, including the plan to paint the local hall green. However, due to a mix-up with the paint numbers, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a glaring bright blue with a red roof. Although the village is initially shocked by the hideous result, public sympathy shifts in favor of the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on a springtime walk to celebrate her unofficial birthday. As they explore the woods and name a hidden pool, they discover the forgotten garden of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares the tragic love story behind it.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) talk about Hester Gray's life and story while resting in her garden. They spend the afternoon exploring the surrounding woods and sharing lunch by a brook, engaging in poetic conversations about nature and souls before walking home at sunset.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), discussing community news and preparations for an upcoming bazaar. At home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) receives a letter from the twins' uncle postponing his taking them, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remembers a past conversation with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) following his jam-stealing episode. Later, at an [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) meeting, the members are outraged to learn that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence for advertisements, and a committee sent to reason with him returns unsuccessful.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) visit [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) to convince him not to rent his fences for advertising, but he refuses their request. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally overhears Judson taking a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) near the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Fearing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) will expose the bribe, Judson quickly agrees to pull his advertising agreement, allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to announce to the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) that the fences are saved.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed and chats with him before [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signals her to come over with news of a potential replacement willow-ware platter at the Copp place. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive to [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) to search for the platter, but upon finding the Copp home empty, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) climbs onto a small duck house to peek into the pantry window. She crashes through the roof and gets trapped, having to wait through a rainstorm until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns and releases her with an axe, after which Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) offers to sell her the platter over tea.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) apologizes to Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp for looking through her window while trying to purchase the blue willow-ware platter. Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) hosts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for tea, complaining about her sister Martha, and agrees to sell the platter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for twenty-five dollars to help fund her upcoming marriage. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive home down the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), laughing over the day's events as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) holds her new treasure.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves for town while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays home and handles chores, including transferring feathers between ticks, which leaves her covered in fluff. Mistaking a bottle of dye for her freckle lotion, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally colors her nose bright red right before [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). After quickly washing off the dye, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) host the distinguished guests for a pleasant meal and a stroll through the local sights before they depart.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolroom antics from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and comforting [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) frightens her with ghost stories. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) set out to walk to a tea party in [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#east-grafton), but accidentally wander down an enchanted wood lane that leads them to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites the lost girls inside to join her for a tea party she had been playfully imagining by herself.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy a merry tea party and explore the charming surroundings of [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) demonstrates the garden's enchanting echoes and explains how her young maid came by her numerical moniker. Before the girls depart, a slip of the tongue brings up [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's name, leaving Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) visibly moved and quiet as she gives them lavendar and bids them farewell.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) worries about [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaving for [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and asks if she has romantic feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) denies. They talk about [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) before reaffirming their deep, lifelong friendship with each other.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rest after picking apples and reflect on how much their lives and community are changing as they grow older and prepare to leave for college. On her walk home from the post office, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and feels a new tension between them when he holds her hand on the bridge. She returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to comfort [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) before slipping away to [Victoria Island](../codex/places.md#victoria-island) to escape her troubles in daydreaming.
>
> — v3 · Chapter I The Shadow of Change

> [The Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Young People's [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) hosts a farewell party for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave for college, presenting them with tokens of appreciation. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is annoyed by Gilbert's sentimental remark during supper and accepts Charlie Sloane's escort home, which leaves her regretting her choice. The following evening, after receiving well-meaning but discouraging comments from local women about attending [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) takes a long walk with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) through the woods where they find a wild apple tree and rekindle their comfortable companionship.
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a rainy morning after an emotional farewell, traveling by train and boat to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie. Upon arrival, she is met at the station by [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who cheers her up on the way to their new boarding house.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), aided by Philippa Gordon's social popularity, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gains status after leading the Freshmen to victory in the Arts Rush. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives her first batch of letters from home, including updates from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), as well as a note from [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) revealing that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been writing to her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her first term at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays. She is warmly welcomed by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md), and she comforts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a bedtime confession. Over the holidays, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives letters from friends, visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and enjoys reuniting with her loved ones.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

> While spending the night in Anne's room, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) unexpectedly delivers a marriage proposal on behalf of her shy brother, [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) declines the unromantic offer, and [Jane](../character/jane.md) accepts the refusal with slight coldness, noting [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) will likely move on to [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md). After [Jane](../character/jane.md) departs the next morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) laughs at the absurdity of her first proposal by proxy, though she feels disappointed that her romantic dreams were crushed by such a unromantic reality.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VIII Anne’s First Proposal

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and notices changes in the community during Sunday church, including the marriage of [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) and news that [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) is terminally ill. The next evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) to drop off jelly before going to see Ruby. At the Gillis home, Ruby tries to maintain a lively facade about her social life and future plans despite her deteriorating health.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XI The Round of Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her new story, "Averil's Atonement," with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), both of whom offer varying critiques. After finishing the manuscript, she submits it to two different publications, but receives rejections from both. Disheartened by the experience, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to lock the story away and give up her literary ambitions.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XII “Averil’s Atonement”

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits a dying [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully confesses her fear of death and her reluctance to leave the earthly life she loves. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offers gentle comfort and reflects deeply on life's true purpose as she walks home. The following night, Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community to mourn her and reflect on her memory.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIV The Summons

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends return to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) for their Sophomore year and settle comfortably into [Patty’s Place](../codex/places.md#patty-s-place). After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is unexpectedly adopted by a stray cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), the girls fail to humane-euthanize him, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to keep him. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperone the household, bringing along her own cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the Sarah-cat.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chats with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) on the doorstep about local gossip, school, and Diana's upcoming wedding. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wanders to the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), contemplating her complicated feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), as well as her sadness about [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) moving away after marriage.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding day at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their long friendship as [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) heads down to marry [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then walks with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) into the parlor and later through Lovers' Lane, where they talk about their past, their mutual acquaintances, and Anne's upcoming summer plans.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling disappointed and lonely after breaking off her relationship with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md). She catches up on local news with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), learns about Jane's upcoming marriage to a rich man, attends Phil's wedding in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), and visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) after the birth of her baby boy.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk with him to Hester Gray's garden, but she has to decline to prepare for Alice Penhallow's wedding. The next day, they go on their walk together to the old garden, where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) again. She accepts him, and they clarify past misunderstandings about [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md) and [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) before walking home together engaged.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XLI Love Takes Up the Glass of Time
